paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for different consistency methods. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” with a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 12.5 with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” with a linear scale ranging from 24.0 to 31.0 with tick labels at intervals of 1.0.  A blue line with circle markers represents “Inconsistency-CE”, starting at approximately (2.0, 24.0) and increasing to approximately (12.5, 30.5). An orange dashed line represents “Consistency-Bi +sampling”, beginning at approximately (2.0, 25.5), increasing to approximately (5.0, 29.0), and continuing to approximately (12.5, 30.0). A green solid line with square markers represents “Consistency-Bi +beam”, starting at approximately (2.0, 27.0) and increasing to approximately (12.5, 31.0).
